lines.speaker: HARPER
lines.text: I cannot believe my husband Cole lied to me about being a billionaire Whitmore heir while my sister Mia needed surgery.
Harper frantically rifles through Evelyn Whitmore's mahogany desk to find any trace of the late matriarch's true medical records.

lines.speaker: DIANE
lines.text: Looking for your late grandmother-in-law Evelyn's personal medical diary, twenty-four-year-old nurse Harper?
Diane Whitmore steps out from the shadows holding a pair of heavy silver candlesticks with a cold smile.

lines.speaker: HARPER
lines.text: You poisoned fifty-eight-year-old stepmother Diane, and I found the hidden pages proving you murdered Evelyn for control.
Diane lunges forward and drops a diamond-encrusted family heirloom necklace directly into Harper's open handbag.

scenes.heading: INT. WHITMORE MANSION - FOYER - SECONDS LATER

lines.text: INT. WHITMORE MANSION - FOYER - SECONDS LATER

lines.speaker: DIANE
lines.text: Security, arrest thirty-two-year-old nurse Harper for stealing our most priceless family heirloom from the study!
Two armed security guards grab Harper by both arms as she struggles against the frame-up.

lines.speaker: COLE
lines.text: Let go of my wife Harper right now, Diane, or I will destroy your entire board majority tonight!
Thirty-two-year-old CEO Cole Whitmore stumbles out of a black sedan with his hospital bandages stained red.

lines.speaker: DIANE
lines.text: Too late, stepson Cole, because the police are already arresting your wife for grand larceny!
Flashing blue sirens illuminate the driveway as two Boston police officers slap handcuffs on Harper.
